schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE ACTIVITY (
    PLAYER_ID INT,
    EVENT_DATE DATE,
    DEVICE_ID INT,
    GAMES_PLAYED INT,
    PRIMARY KEY (PLAYER_ID, EVENT_DATE),
    CHECK (GAMES_PLAYED >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT A1.FIRST_LOGIN AS INSTALL_DT, COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN (A1.FIRST_LOGIN + 1) = A2.EVENT_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/ COUNT(DISTINCT A1.PLAYER_ID)), 2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM (SELECT PLAYER_ID, MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS FIRST_LOGIN FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) AS A1 JOIN ACTIVITY AS A2 ON A1.PLAYER_ID = A2.PLAYER_ID GROUP BY A1.FIRST_LOGIN
q2: SELECT INSTALL_DT, COUNT(INSTALLTBL2.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND(COUNT(ACTIVITY.PLAYER_ID)/COUNT(INSTALLTBL2.PLAYER_ID),2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM ( ( SELECT INSTALL_DT, DATE_ADD(INSTALL_DT,INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS RETENTION_DT, PLAYER_ID FROM (SELECT MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS INSTALL_DT, PLAYER_ID FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) INSTALLTBL ) INSTALLTBL2 LEFT JOIN ACTIVITY ON INSTALLTBL2.RETENTION_DT = ACTIVITY.EVENT_DATE AND INSTALLTBL2.PLAYER_ID = ACTIVITY.PLAYER_ID ) GROUP BY INSTALL_DT

q2_prompt_sql: SELECT INSTALL_DT, COUNT(INSTALLTBL2.PLAYER_ID) AS INSTALLS, ROUND(COUNT(ACTIVITY.PLAYER_ID)/COUNT(INSTALLTBL2.PLAYER_ID),2) AS DAY1_RETENTION FROM ( ( SELECT INSTALL_DT, DATE_ADD(INSTALL_DT,INTERVAL 1 DAY) AS RETENTION_DT, PLAYER_ID FROM (SELECT MIN(EVENT_DATE) AS INSTALL_DT, PLAYER_ID FROM ACTIVITY GROUP BY PLAYER_ID) INSTALLTBL ) INSTALLTBL2 LEFT JOIN ACTIVITY ON INSTALLTBL2.RETENTION_DT = ACTIVITY.EVENT_DATE AND INSTALLTBL2.PLAYER_ID = ACTIVITY.PLAYER_ID ) GROUP BY INSTALL_DT

explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because they handle the calculation of day1_retention differently. Q1 calculates the day1_retention as the ratio of players who made an event on the day after their first login to the total number of players. Q2, on the other hand, calculates the day1_retention as the ratio of players who made an event on the day after their first login to the total number of players who had a first login.
counterexample_dsp: A player who has a first login on day 1 and makes an event on day 2, but no other events.
